schema.item.slot_head: {lineage "4.N", root #, head #} - slot plays newest READY+APPROVED version at/below head (checker.slot_head)
schema.item.versions: add-only list of {global_no, gen, parent, supersedes, slot_id, prompt_ids, status: candidate|head|superseded, superseded_by, superseded_at}
schema.slot.anchors: [in_anchor, out_anchor] clean-master frames every version in the slot must match
schema.prompt_queue: COMMENT-PROMPTS.jsonl add-only; state waiting|combined|aired|held via new rows; max_wait_loops default 3
schema.duplicates: exact sha/phash: air once, extra copies linked duplicate_of; near-dupes sibling: rotate|next_take|spinoff
